== Description ==
Players Committee gallery image of [[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court) (PC Gallery Text)|Tusken Breath Mask (V)]], present in the Internet Archive capture of 3 December 2007 at 11:05:50 UTC. It shows the earlier remastered gallery wording recorded on that page. The capture establishes that the image was available by that time, not its first publication day.
